items.stem: 'An economy left to itself will always reach full employment.' Evaluate this view in the light of the Great Depression.
items.answer: Classical view – flexible wages and prices clear markets; evidence of the Depression – unemployment rose from about 3% to 25% in the USA and output fell; Keynes – deficient aggregate demand can keep the economy at less than full employment; so the view is not generally valid in the short run; government policy may be needed.
